text.c01: [proudly] Ah, you've come. I've been waiting.
text.c02: [warmly] Come, sit there. Tonight is my banquet.
text.c03: [politely] Welcome. We are honoured you came.
text.c04: [calmly] I, Ee-yeh-yah-soo, shall keep you company tonight.
text.c08: [politely] First, a cup of warm sake. …See the steam rising?
text.c09: [excited] Right — let us all drink! Kanpai!
text.c12: [teasing] What's this? Surely you can drink more?
text.c13: [concerned] Don't push yourself. Just a sip, to start.
text.c17: [whispers] I am looking past this land — to what lies beyond.
text.c18: [politely] And this is chilled sake, kept on ice.
text.c19: [whispers] …For all his bluster, Lord Nobunaga gets lonely.
text.c20: [whispers] So stay with him tonight, at your ease.
text.c21: [suspicious] What are you two whispering about?
text.c23: [surprised] Oh… the wind has grown strong.
text.c26: [calmly] Do not worry. It is only the night wind.
text.c28: [proudly] Hmph. A little wind won't end my banquet.
text.c35: [whispers] …Listen to the rain. Not bad, is it?
text.c36: [whispers] A night like this never comes twice.
text.c39: [warmly] One last cup. You too — take yours.
